Focused tests cover release/source mismatches, changed manifest and asset bytes, all nine predecessor identities, current caller selection and fixture identity preservation. Custody authentication is not native upgrade qualification, signing or technical acceptance.
The dedicated Space Is Fake/K2 upgrade oracles retain their original transitions. Current native upgrades and joined campaign/seal/publication bindings remain outstanding.
